description: The sibling sites Canari opens (docs/wiki/backlog.d/sign-in-handoff-to-the-ecosystem-sites-and-migallery-notifications.md, owner 2026-11-07/08), in the launcher's order. `origin` is where each answers today. `miconnect` says it signs in through MiConnect, which is the ONLY condition for being in the handoff registry. `handoff` turns the one-time sign-in handoff ON for that site and may be true only when ALL of these hold: (1) core-service performs F3-bound's MiConnect access check at mint (the user is active, the target application `miconnectApplication` has no enabled policy binding and `core_default_app_access` is not false - the inputs from which `check_access` would answer, since authentik 2026.8 honours its `for_user` for a superuser only) - without it a handoff bypasses MiConnect's access decisions; (2) the site's provider `sub_mode` was read as `hashed_user_id`; (3) the site's own redemption (`/auth/handoff`) is LIVE in production, with its handoff sessions marked and its state-changing actions behind a fresh MiConnect sign-in (design note, section 3.7). `miconnectApplication` is the site's application slug at MiConnect, which the access check reads. `dests` is the closed allowlist of paths a handoff may land on (`{uuid}` stands for one lowercase UUID segment); a page whose purpose is an action needing that fresh sign-in is not on it (MiGallery's `/mes-photos/confirmer`). It also bounds what a link someone else wrote can do: a link to a flagged site tapped in a message or a post is handed off only when its path is exactly one of these, with no query and no fragment, and opens plainly otherwise (owner, 2026-11-25). `signIn` is the site's own MiConnect sign-in entry (`path`), and the query parameter it reads a return path from (`returnParam`, null when it reads none, so the sign-in lands on the site's home): a refused mint whose refusal is a page MiConnect must show the person first (the terms, the Alumni link step, the Alumni gate) opens the site THERE, with a `dest` of the allowlist as the return path, so the person sees MiConnect's page once and lands signed in where they were going (owner, 2026-11-25); null outside MiConnect. core-service's registry (apps/core-service/src/auth/handoff/handoff-sites.ts) and the frontend's (frontend/src/lib/navigation/ecosystemSites.ts) each assert their copy equals this file.
